recommendation_summary: Act now: keep the single team and the existing tracker. Give every PR a primary and a backup reviewer, using the two qualified, authorized engineers as backups. Make the backup take over automatically when the primary is absent, and reassign PRs waiting on the absent lead today. Set a one-working-day first-review expectation and rotate a brief daily check of the review queue. Track time from ready-for-review to approval, and compare after one and two weeks. Squads/chapters, Jira Align and quarterly workshops are deferred until a coordination problem appears that the tracker cannot handle, so there are no present optional additions. Unmet need: none apparent; the reply directly ensures changes stop waiting on the absent lead.
note: The recommendation is a bounded reviewer-coverage fix with the larger stack deferred conditionally, but none of the four required labeled record lines appear.
